H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H8145: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H4109: a walk, i.e. a passage or a distance
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2490: properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H2015: to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert
H539: properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H3847: properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively
H8242: properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H6996: abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance)
H5060: properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.)
H3678: properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H155: something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3680: properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H2199: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
H2940: properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H929: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
H1241: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H3972: properly, a speck or point, i.e. (by implication) something; with negative, nothing
H7462: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H2555: violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H5162: properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
